[Important] Rahti security update and improvement Dear Rahti user, You are receiving this email because you have an active account on the CSC Rahti service. Rahti applies a custom secure computing profile (seccomp) to all workloads instead of the container runtime default. This is a proactive cautionary step as part of a response to improve platform controls in response to a recent increase in security vulnerabilities. What seccomp is * Secure Computing is a mechanism for container runtimes to restrict the system calls available to containers. What changes * Newly created pods will have the following in their security context instead of RuntimeDefault: seccompProfile: type: Localhost localhostProfile: rahti-custom-seccomp.json * Workloads that are already running continue to run with their current profile. The custom profile is applied automatically the next time a pod is created. * A warning appears if the pod has set the seccomp to RuntimeDefault. Starting from 10 November 2026, 10:00 AM the pod will be denied by admission controller. What you must do * Check your CronJobs, Deployments, Jobs and StatefulSets for a seccompProfile setting.
